description: DeepSeek Harness web UI + LAN proxies + password portal. Machine values live here; secrets live in gitignored files or env, never in code.

ports.lan_http_note: trusted LAN only: bearer cookie has no Secure flag

lan_host.how: bin/start.sh and portal auto-detect via hostname -I; override with DSH_LAN_HOST env

public_host_note: tailnet MagicDNS name with tailscale-serve trusted cert. WebAuthn rpId MUST be this hostname — passkeys fail on bare IPs. Passkey login/registration only work via the public URL.
ts_serve_note: tailscale serve mappings (persistent in tailscaled): :9443 -> 127.0.0.1:8090 (portal), :9444 -> 127.0.0.1:8443 (dsh). Re-apply with: tailscale serve --bg --https=9443 https+insecure://127.0.0.1:8090 ; tailscale serve --bg --https=9444 https+insecure://127.0.0.1:8443

portal_password.format: 0600 gitignored scrypt hash, never in repo
portal_password.change: via the portal web UI itself (logged-in sessions can set a new one)
portal_password.initial_delivery: shown once in chat, never logged

portal_users.format: 0600 gitignored: accounts, passkey credential IDs + public keys + counters, single-use invites
portal_users.bootstrap: empty file = open registration creates the admin; afterwards invites only
portal_users.recovery: shared password login still works as break-glass admin

dsh_launch_token.handling: portal reads it live on each /open redirect; never commit, never paste into chats/logs

cert.note: browsers warn on self-signed either way; delete to regenerate
